item.title: Jack Hughes scores in overtime as US beats Canada for gold at the Olympics
item.description: The United States is atop the hockey world for the first time in nearly a half-century. Jack Hughes scored the winning goal in overtime, and the U.S. defeated Canada 2-1 in the gold medal final

item.title: 2 dead after driver crashes vehicle into warehouse on Detroit's west side
item.description: 2 people are dead after a driver crashed a vehicle into a building on Detroit's west side on Sunday morning, the Detroit Police Department tells us.

item.title: Wayne State alumni and friends bring halal café dream to Midtown Detroit
item.description: Childhood friends who studied at Wayne State University have opened a new halal café just steps from their alma mater, creating what they call "a little slice of home" in Midtown Detroit.
